message: 決戦、そして……
After today's Student Council activities ended--

name: Synn
message: 「A-Are you sure? Really?」

name: Shio
message: 「Leave it to me! I know this shop like the back of my hand. Ahahaha!」

name: Shio
message: 「Sir Synn has been taking time between Student Council duties to assist me with my training. This is the very least I can do to show my gratitude.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I see. Well then, I won't hold back...」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Welcome. Welcome to Chocolat l'Or!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hello. Thanks for having me again.」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Oh my, Mr. Student Council President. It's been a while.」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Um, is this person with you... a first-time visitor?」

name: Shio
message: 「*Gulp*」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Is that true, Shio-chan?」

name: Shio
message: 「Hahahaha. I-It appears I... mistook this establishment for another.」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Oh, I see.」

name: Shio
message: 「However, we cannot simply leave after merely browsing. Come, let us proceed inside.」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Please, take your time♪」

name: Shio
message: 「Come, come, please make yourself comfortable and take a seat.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah.」
Shio-chan has seemed restless for a while now... and she keeps sneaking glances at a piece of paper hidden in her hand.

name: Fuyuka
message: 「What would you like to order?」

name: Shio
message: 「Two choco-late cakes. And some tea as well, if you would be so kind.」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Certainly, would gateau chocolat and Darjeeling tea be alright?」

name: Shio
message: 「I leave it to your judgment.」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Ahaha...\s02」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Come to think of it, isn't Nanaka-san with you today?」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Oh, right. Today I'm actually the one being treated.」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「My, is that so? Please continue to grace us with your patronage.」

name: Synn
message: 「Shion-chan?」

name: Shio
message: 「Lord Synn... Have you been here with Lady Nanaka before?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I have.」

name: Shio
message: 「Lord Synn... Y-You went on a date with someone other than me...」

name: Shio
message: 「No! Today was meant to be my way of thanking Lord Synn... A-And yet...」

name: Shio
message: 「Why is this hazy, restless feeling welling up inside me like this...」

name: Shio
message: 「Just being together with Lord Synn used to fill me with joy...」

name: Shio
message: 「Why does my chest ache so painfully now...」

name: Shio
message: 「I'll leave the payment right here...」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Shio
message: 「I... am not feeling quite well, so I shall take my leave.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Wait, the cake hasn't even arrived yet?」

name: Shio
message: 「Excuse me!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, wait up, Shion-chan!」

name: Shio
message: 「T-This feeling... I knew it, I have fallen for Lord Synn--」

name: Synn
message: 「Hold on, Shion-chan!」

name: Shio
message: 「Unhand me, please!」

name: Synn
message: 「What's gotten into you all of a sudden?」

name: Shio
message: 「Y-You and Lady Nanaka... are lovers... Had you told me from the start, I could have spared us this impertinence!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaaat?!」

name: Shio
message: 「Did the shopkeeper not just say so?! That the two of you often show your faces at the shop together!」

name: Synn
message: 「You've got it wrong, Shio-chan. That was--」

name: Synn
message: 「T-This presence--!!」

name: Shio
message: 「Farewell!」

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan, a Demon!」

name: Shio
message: 「What did you say?!」
In a corner of the shopping district, a Cat Demon is on a rampage.
As Crusaders, we can't just leave it like this.

name: Synn
message: 「It's a good chance to show the results of our training... but fighting when you're not in top condition is way too dangerous」

name: Shio
message: 「P-Please wait!」

name: Shio
message: 「What happened just now was, um... I merely lost my temper a little」

name: Synn
message: 「If you're like that in a real fight, it'll be even more dangerous」

name: Shio
message: 「Th-That is because Sir Synn...」

name: Shio
message: 「Because I heard that Sir Synn was going on a date with another girl, I j-just...」

name: Shio
message: 「Urgh...」

name: Synn
message: 「Like I said, that's not it! I went with Nanaka to scout her during Kirafes」

name: Shio
message: 「Wh-What...」

name: Synn
message: 「So, she's not my girlfriend or anything like that」

name: Shio
message: 「What a blunder. To think I jumped to conclusions!」

name: Synn
message: 「Can you really do this?」

name: Shio
message: 「Leave it to me. My preparations are complete」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll focus purely on pinning down its movements, so... I'm counting on you!」

name: Shio
message: 「As you command!」
